item.title: Show HN: Open Logs - Self-hosted log management on your own Cloudflare account (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN, I built Open Logs, a log manager that runs on your own Cloudflare account. I wanted a simple place to send logs from my own apps without running a server, so I built it on Workers and Basin. It's one Worker (Hono + React), D1 for app data, and logs go Pipelines → Iceberg in your own R2 bucket → Basin SQL. You get live tail, search, dashboards and alerts with webhooks. npm run setup creates everything in your account. Things I learned: every Basin SQL query is billed at a 10 MB minimum, which shaped most of the UI (cache everything, refresh only live data). Logs take 30 seconds to 3 minutes to become searchable, so the UI says so instead of pretending to be real time. Website: https://adithya188288.github.io/open-logs/ How I built it: https://codezenk.me/blog/open-logs Free and MIT licensed. Feedback welcome. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50516451 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
